Description: Monitor Antigravity tasks and control the selected Desktop conversation: new task, approval, rejection, stop, pin, fork when available, reasoning options, composer submission, prompt shortcuts, microphone and scrolling. Transcript tokens are estimates; unavailable quota and context values remain unknown.
